messages:
nora: Heads-up — spotted a 404 on an embedded diagram in the KB page for inference runtimes (seen when previewing the runtime caching section). The image path is /assets/diagrams/kv-cache-v2.svg, CDN returns 404. Anyone owning that page who can rehost or swap the link?

linkscan-bot: auto-scan result: docs/inference/kv-cache.md -> 1 broken image (assets/diagrams/kv-cache-v2.svg). Reported by nora at 2024-04-02. Use /docs-assets or rehost to s3.

sam: I can take this. Quick question — is the svg supposed to be internal-only? If not, I can rehost to our public assets bucket and open a tiny PR to update the path.

nora: Thanks sam. I think it was originally exported from Figma then uploaded last year; not sure if the upload failed during migration. Public is fine for this diagram.

kai: Ping @sam — if you're rehosting, could you also make a small alt text tweak? Current alt is just "diagram" and we want it to be "KV-cache flow diagram" for accessibility.

sam: Yep — plan: 1) fetch original file from design team (or export from Figma if needed) 2) upload to s3://redwood-docs-public/assets/diagrams/kv-cache-v2.svg 3) update docs/inference/kv-cache.md reference to https://assets.redwood.ai/diagrams/kv-cache-v2.svg and fix alt text 4) open PR and assign to nora for content review. Will do in afternoon.

ashley: Quick ask — can we also add a redirect rule for the old shortlink (short.redwood/docs/kv-cache-svg) so any embedded apps referencing the old path don't break during propagation? If it's cheap we should do it in the same change.

sam: Good call. I can add an nginx redirect in the infra repo as part of the PR (small config change). If ops prefers a CloudFront redirect rule, tag me and I'll coordinate.

linkscan-bot: scheduled re-scan queued after PR merge to verify fixes.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — includes: rehosted svg to s3, updated markdown link, improved alt text, and a redirect stub in infra/nginx/redirects.d/kv-cache.conf with comment for ops. Assigned to nora and ashley for review.

nora: Reviewing now. Looks good at a glance. Thanks for adding alt text and redirect stub.

kai: small nit in the PR: the markdown image link uses inline width attribute that our linting removed previously. Suggest removing the width attribute and letting CSS handle sizing.

sam: Good catch — pushed a follow-up commit to drop the width attribute.

ashley: Approving infra stub but flagged ops channel for CloudFront propagation (ops might prefer CFT rule). I'll loop ops.

nora: Approved the docs change. Once ops confirms redirect approach and the infra change is merged, we can merge the docs PR and let linkscan-bot do the final check. :thumbsup:

linkscan-bot: post-merge scan (pending): will re-run nightly and report new status in #docs.

sam: Merged docs PR and applied nginx stub in infra branch — ops asked for a quick CloudFront rule; ops will apply and let me know when propagated.

ashley: Ops confirmed CloudFront rule applied and TTL cleared. I re-ran preview and the svg loads. Closing out.

nora: Awesome — thanks everyone. Marking this thread resolved.
